recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless PA explicitly reopens the date-only birthDate policy for these resources.
issue_request: The 2015 May ballot issue proposed changing Practitioner.birthDate from date to dateTime for consistency with Person, but the Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution instead directed that Person.birthDate be changed to date for consistency with the other person-type resources.
initial_application: Commit 0522d003c90c49a5774028204610056c3360d1c6 applied the decision by changing Person.birthDate in source/person/person-spreadsheet.xml from dateTime to date and adding date-only rationale.
additional_context: Person, Practitioner, Patient, and RelatedPerson are active current-build resources and all currently define birthDate as date. FHIR-7307 is the companion RelatedPerson date-only change; FHIR-14441 later aligned the person-resource pattern without changing the birthDate type; FHIR-35090 later clarified birthDate comments without changing the datatype. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that contradicts the Jira and source history.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already matches the final issue resolution. No source edit was needed, and changing Practitioner.birthDate to dateTime would be contrary to the accepted resolution.

related_jiras.note: Companion 2015 PA issue added RelatedPerson.birthDate as date, reinforcing the date-only resource-family outcome.
Later Patient/Practitioner/RelatedPerson/Person pattern alignment kept birthDate as date and is already audited on the combined branch.
Later birthDate comment clarification did not change the datatype and is already represented on the combined branch.
